summary: Move the web composer outbox onto shared optimistic mutations

replay.detail: Composer overlays remain in-memory; no durable replay changes.

schema.detail: No wire or storage schema changes.

rules.detail: Server admission, capability checks and snapshot fences remain authoritative.

compatibility.detail: Preserves immediate message drawing, submission order, retained failures and identical same-key retries. ACKs keep the outbox row until identity-correlated authoritative content arrives; omitted rows never prove delivery.

recovery.detail: Reloading discards client overlays without changing authoritative messages.
